items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: the Graham Bell band, uh, was styled more on the Lou Waters type than anything else

ctx.x: How did they sound, uh, the, uh, Southern Jazz Group and Graham Bell? Are they... would you think that they had any particular model, or...?

Well, the, the Graham Bell band, uh, was styled more on the Lou Waters type than anything else, with the peculiarly Australian sound, uh, I always think. It might be Roger Bell's trumpet, that's the quarter there. Um. Um. The... Southern Jazz Group were, were less, uh, less stilted, I'd say. Um. Had a wonderful, uh, tuba player, Bob Wright. Very, uh, very good player.

I still, when I listen to them, I think, you know, of this King Oliver, and, uh, I think, uh, King Oliver influence, coming down through waters and all that. Yes. When I, what a little I've heard of them, you know. Mm. They're still in that general framework, huh?
